run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T00:47:54Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The warning alert is produced by Prometheus's own rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers, whose expression is `max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1` with `for: 10m` (rule file stored in ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0). The condition is about Alertmanager discovery by the notifier, not about a failing scrape. At query time no Alertmanager component exists anywhere in the cluster: the delivered complete lists of 66 pods, 52 Services, 36 Deployments and 6 StatefulSets contain no Alertmanager workload or Service, no Endpoints object resolves an Alertmanager address, and namespace prometheus holds only two ConfigMaps (kube-root-ca.crt and the rule files ConfigMap), so no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap exists there. The Alertmanager CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com is installed and Established, so the operator could reconcile an Alertmanager if one existed. Prometheus itself is not crashed: prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 2026-11-17T00:47:22Z (containers started 00:47:23Z, restartCount 0, empty lastState, Ready), 32 s before the recorded alert start, while its StatefulSet is generation 1 with an unchanged pod template created 2026-11-16T01:33:54Z, so the recreation is a mechanism whose trigger is not visible (retained events begin only at 00:55:14Z and none belong to namespace prometheus). The rendered alerting configuration could not be verified: the Prometheus/Alertmanager custom resources and the generated config secret are not readable and the pod/operator logs returned no bytes; the tool-accessible Prometheus holds 63 metric names but no prometheus_* series, so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered could not be read directly. Whether the Alertmanager was never installed or was removed shortly before 00:47 remains unresolved, and no evidence ties otel-demo application traffic to this condition.

claims.text: The rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers exists in ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, severity warning, and its description/summary text matches the alert under investigation.

Cluster-wide there are 6 StatefulSets and none is named alertmanager; in namespace prometheus the only StatefulSet is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, owned by the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.

The complete cluster pod list (66 pods) contains no Alertmanager pod; namespace prometheus contains 8 pods (prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and five node-exporter pods) and none is an Alertmanager.

The complete cluster Service list (52 Services) contains no Alertmanager Service (no *-alertmanager and no alertmanager-operated); in namespace prometheus the Services are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter, and the Endpoints collected for them contain no Alertmanager address.

The complete cluster Deployment list (36 Deployments) contains no Alertmanager deployment; the only prometheus/alertmanager matching deployments are prometheus/prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (prometheus-operator v0.85.0, replicas 1, ready 1) and prometheus/prometheus-kube-state-metrics (v2.17.0, replicas 1, ready 1).
The only ConfigMaps in namespace prometheus are kube-root-ca.crt and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0, so no Alertmanager configuration ConfigMap exists in that namespace.

Among the 10 PersistentVolumeClaims in the cluster there is no Alertmanager claim; the Prometheus statefulset's data volume prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-db is an emptyDir, not a PVC.

The CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (kind Alertmanager) is installed and has NamesAccepted=True and Established=True, so the operator has the API type to reconcile Alertmanager objects even though no Alertmanager workload exists.

Pod prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was created at 2026-11-17T00:47:22Z and its prometheus and config-reloader containers started at 2026-11-17T00:47:23Z with restartCount 0, Ready=True and an empty lastState, i.e. a recreated pod rather than a crashed container.

StatefulSet prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus was created 2026-11-16T01:33:54Z with generation 1, replicas 1 and readyReplicas 1, and its pod template annotations contain only kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container, no restart/config-revision marker, so the pod recreation at 00:47:22Z was not caused by a visible StatefulSet spec change.

The alert's instance label 100.96.5.74:9090 corresponds to pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0: the Endpoints of Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (and of prometheus-operated) map 100.96.5.74:9090 to that pod on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a.
All five nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False, DiskPressure=False and PIDPressure=False, and the Prometheus pod runs on i-0bc0544469bfef13a, which is Ready with no pressure conditions.

The tool-accessible Prometheus serves 63 metric names, including traces_span_metrics_calls_total, container_* and process_* metrics, and that list contains no prometheus_* series, so the alerting signal prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered could not be read from it.

Within the authorized window the retained cluster events group only into namespace data-recorders (Deployment/Job/PVC/Pod/ReplicaSet/StatefulSet reasons) and namespace otel-demo (Deployment ScalingReplicaSet, Pod/ReplicaSet create-kill/start reasons); no event at all was returned for namespace prometheus, and the oldest retained event is 2026-11-17T00:55:14Z, after the 00:47:22Z pod creation.

The Prometheus pod was not crash-looping or OOM-killed: restartCount is 0 for both prometheus and config-reloader, lastState is empty for all containers, Ready=True, and the operator and kube-state-metrics pods in the same namespace have been running with restartCount 0 since 2026-11-16T01:33:54Z.

A sampled otel-demo pod unrelated to alerting was transacting normally: pod otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-w2nmh logged repeated '[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed' and 'order confirmation email sent' lines; this single sample does not by itself establish overall application health.

Rejected: Prometheus lost its Alertmanager connection because its container crashed, was OOMKilled, or is evicted/restart-looping. The containers show restartCount 0, an empty lastState (no terminated reason or exit code) and Ready=True, and no Evicted/OOMKilling/Unhealthy event exists for the pod in the retained events.

Rejected: node-level resource pressure or node unavailability preventing operation of the Prometheus or an Alertmanager workload. All five nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False.

Primary explanation: no Alertmanager is deployed or referenced in this cluster, so the Prometheus notifier discovers zero Alertmanager targets and max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered[5m]) stays below 1, firing the rule after 10m. Support: the complete pod, Service, Deployment, StatefulSet and Endpoints lists contain no Alertmanager object, namespace prometheus has no Alertmanager config ConfigMap, and the Alertmanager CRD is Established, so an Alertmanager CR could be reconciled if one existed. The rendered alerting block in the generated Prometheus config secret could not be read to confirm it is empty.

Alternative explanation: an Alertmanager object (Alertmanager CR plus its operator-owned StatefulSet/Service) was removed shortly before the recorded alert start, and the simultaneous recreation of the Prometheus pod at 2026-11-17T00:47:22Z, 32 s before the 00:47:54Z alert start, was part of the same change. Unresolved: retained events begin only at 00:55:14Z, no prometheus-namespace events exist, the Prometheus/Alertmanager custom resources and generated config secret are not readable, and change history is not integrated.

Read the Prometheus custom resource prometheus/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (spec.alerting.alertmanagers) and the kube-prometheus-stack release values (alertmanager.enabled and the Alertmanager name/namespace). If an Alertmanager is intended, ensure an Alertmanager CR exists so the operator renders its endpoints into the Prometheus config; if it is intentionally disabled, suppress or remove the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule rather than leaving it firing.

Use cluster audit logs / change history and the Prometheus operator logs (currently unreadable through the log tool) to determine whether the Alertmanager CR or the Helm values changed just before 2026-11-17T00:47:22Z, and restore Prometheus self-metric collection (prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered) so the discovery state can be tracked directly.

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. content:
groups:
- name: prometheus
  rules:
  - alert: PrometheusBadConfig
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        reload its configuration.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusbadconfig
      summary: Failed Prometheus configuration reload.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_config_last_reload_successful{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) == 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusSDRefreshFailure
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        refresh SD with mechanism {{$labels.mechanism}}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheussdrefreshfailure
      summary: Failed Prometheus SD refresh.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_refresh_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[10m])
      > 0
    for: 20m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusKubernetesListWatchFailures
    annotations:
      description: Kubernetes service discovery of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is experiencing {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} failures with LIST/WATCH requests
        to the Kubernetes API in the last 5 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuskuberneteslistwatchfailures
      summary: Requests in Kubernetes SD are failing.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_kubernetes_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotificationQueueRunningFull
    annotations:
      description: Alert notification queue of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is running full.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotificationqueuerunningfull
      summary: Prometheus alert notification queue predicted to run full in less than
        30m.
    expr: |-
      # Without min_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        predict_linear(prometheus_notifications_queue_length{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m], 60 * 30)
      >
        min_over_time(prometheus_notifications_queue_capacity{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of alerts sent by Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        to Alertmanager {{$labels.alertmanager}} were affected by errors.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers
      summary: More than 1% of alerts sent by Prometheus to a specific Alertmanager
        were affected by errors.
    expr: |-
      (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} reload failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbreloadsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues reloading blocks from disk.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_reloads_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBCompactionsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} compaction failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbcompactionsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues compacting blocks.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotIngestingSamples
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not ingesting
        samples.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotingestingsamples
      summary: Prometheus is not ingesting samples.
    expr: |-
      (
        sum without(type) (rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])) <= 0
      and
        (
          sum without(scrape_job) (prometheus_target_metadata_cache_entries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        or
          sum without(rule_group) (prometheus_rule_group_rules{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        )
      )
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusDuplicateTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with different values but duplicated timestamp.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusduplicatetimestamps
      summary: Prometheus is dropping samples with duplicate timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOutOfOrderTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with timestamps arriving out of order.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusoutofordertimestamps
      summary: Prometheus drops samples with out-of-order timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_out_of_order_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} failed to send
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of the samples to {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotestoragefailures
      summary: Prometheus fails to send samples to remote storage.
    expr: |-
      (
        (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
      /
        (
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        +
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_succeeded_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        )
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write is
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}s behind for {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{ $labels.url
        }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritebehind
      summary: Prometheus remote write is behind.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      -
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      > 120
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteDesiredShards
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write desired
        shards calculation wants to run {{ $value }} shards for queue {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}, which is more than the max of {{ printf `prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{instance="%s",job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}`
        $labels.instance | query | first | value }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritedesiredshards
      summary: Prometheus remote write desired shards calculation wants to run more
        than configured max shards.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_desired{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      >
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRuleFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        evaluate {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} rules in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusrulefailures
      summary: Prometheus is failing rule evaluations.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusMissingRuleEvaluations
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has missed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} rule group evaluations in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusmissingruleevaluations
      summary: Prometheus is missing rule evaluations due to slow rule group evaluation.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_group_iterations_missed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because the number of targets exceeded the
        configured target_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetlimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the targets limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_target_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusLabelLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because some samples exceeded the configured
        label_limit, label_name_length_limit or label_value_length_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuslabellimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the labels limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_label_limits_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeBodySizeLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured body_size_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapebodysizelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped some targets that exceeded body size limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_body_size_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeSampleLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured sample_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapesamplelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has failed scrapes that have exceeded the configured sample
        limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_sample_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetSyncFailure
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.0f" $value }} targets in Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        have failed to sync because invalid configuration was supplied.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetsyncfailure
      summary: Prometheus has failed to sync targets.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_sync_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[30m])
      > 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusHighQueryLoad
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} query API has
        less than 20% available capacity in its query engine for the last 15 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheushighqueryload
      summary: Prometheus is reaching its maximum capacity serving concurrent requests.
    expr: avg_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      / max_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries_concurrent_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0.8
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% minimum errors while sending alerts
        from Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} to any Alertmanager.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstoanyalertmanager
      summary: Prometheus encounters more than 3% errors sending alerts to any Alertmanager.
    expr: |-
      min without (alertmanager) (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 3
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
groups:
- name: prometheus-operator
  rules:
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorListErrors
    annotations:
      description: Errors while performing List operations in controller {{$labels.controller}}
        in {{$labels.namespace}} namespace.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatorlisterrors
      summary: Errors while performing list operations in controller.
    expr: (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_list_operations_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[10m]))
      / sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_list_operations_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[10m])))
      > 0.4
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorWatchErrors
    annotations:
      description: Errors while performing watch operations in controller {{$labels.controller}}
        in {{$labels.namespace}} namespace.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatorwatcherrors
      summary: Errors while performing watch operations in controller.
    expr: (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_watch_operations_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
      / sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_watch_operations_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])))
      > 0.4
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorSyncFailed
    annotations:
      description: Controller {{ $labels.controller }} in {{ $labels.namespace }}
        namespace fails to reconcile {{ $value }} objects.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatorsyncfailed
      summary: Last controller reconciliation failed
    expr: min_over_time(prometheus_operator_syncs{status="failed",job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorReconcileErrors
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of reconciling operations failed
        for {{ $labels.controller }} controller in {{ $labels.namespace }} namespace.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatorreconcileerrors
      summary: Errors while reconciling objects.
    expr: (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_reconcile_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])))
      / (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_reconcile_operations_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])))
      > 0.1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorStatusUpdateErrors
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of status update operations
        failed for {{ $labels.controller }} controller in {{ $labels.namespace }}
        namespace.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatorstatusupdateerrors
      summary: Errors while updating objects status.
    expr: (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_status_update_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])))
      / (sum by (cluster,controller,namespace) (rate(prometheus_operator_status_update_operations_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])))
      > 0.1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorNodeLookupErrors
    annotations:
      description: Errors while reconciling Prometheus in {{ $labels.namespace }}
        Namespace.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus-operator/prometheusoperatornodelookuperrors
      summary: Errors while reconciling Prometheus.
    expr: rate(prometheus_operator_node_address_lookup_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0.1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOperatorNotReady
